epics.title: Autonomous Sovereign Designer Engine
epics.jtbd: When the client requests a new product design, I want the system to autonomously synthesize, render, and visually audit a complete UI/UX mockup, so that high-end design assets are produced without relying on external paid design services.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Mock component elimination rate = 100% and visual audit pass rate >= 99.5%
epics.tocConstraintRef: CCR: Playwright vision rendering throughput and layout synthesis latency
requirements: R1: Define data models and schemas for semantic layout definitions, Obsidian design tokens (#08090C, #11141C, emerald-500), viewport geometry, and audit reports
R2: Define shared API contract for layout synthesis requests, dual-viewport rendering parameters (1440x900 and 375x812), and deontic gate evaluation DTOs
R3: Implement real semantic layout synthesis engine replacing mock components with strict Obsidian design token integration
R4: Implement Playwright vision harness capturing real DOM geometry at desktop 1440x900 and mobile 375x812 viewports
R5: Implement deontic gate visual audit engine and UI enforcing zero optical noise, anti-slop color palette conformance, and WCAG AAA contrast
R6: Implement test pyramid suite spanning unit testing of layout synthesis, integration testing of Playwright rendering, and E2E validation of the visual audit gate

slices.title: Layout Schema and Obsidian Token Data Models
slices.jtbd: When implementing the data persistence layer for this epic, I want structured models for Obsidian design tokens, viewport configurations, and visual audit results, so that the designer engine operates on validated, strongly-typed layout entities.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a layout specification with Obsidian design tokens (#08090C, #11141C, emerald-500),
When the schema validator evaluates the token structure,
Then it validates color hex values, surface hierarchies, and spatial constraints without data loss.
Given an audit report payload with DOM geometry nodes,
When persisted to storage,
Then the audit entities are queryable with complete bounding box and contrast ratio attributes.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Schema serialization overhead and token validation latency
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Schema validation error rate < 0.01% on token definitions

slices.title: Designer Synthesis and Vision Harness Contract Specification
slices.jtbd: When defining the inter-service boundaries for this epic, I want OpenAPI contracts for layout synthesis, Playwright rendering viewports, and deontic gate evaluation DTOs, so that backend synthesis and frontend audit interfaces integrate seamlessly.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an API client requesting layout synthesis,
When submitting layout generation parameters for desktop (1440x900) or mobile (375x812),
Then the contract specifies complete DTO schemas for layout payloads and render options.
Given a deontic gate evaluation response,
When parsed by consuming services,
Then the response shape strictly conforms to the defined optical noise and WCAG contrast schema.
slices.tocConstraintRef: API contract compatibility and schema drift between backend and frontend

slices.title: Semantic Layout Synthesis Engine
slices.jtbd: When implementing the core designer backend for this epic, I want a real semantic layout synthesis engine consuming Obsidian design tokens, so that hardcoded mock components are eliminated and replaced by dynamic, token-compliant layouts.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a design brief requiring layout synthesis,
When the synthesis engine generates the component hierarchy,
Then it assigns Obsidian tokens (#08090C background, #11141C cards, emerald-500 accents) with zero mock fallback elements.
Given malformed or incomplete token inputs,
When synthesis is triggered,
Then the engine gracefully falls back to default token primitives while returning structured diagnostics.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Layout synthesis compute latency and AST tree generation throughput
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Mock component presence = 0% and synthesis failure rate < 0.1%

slices.title: Playwright Vision Harness Multi-Viewport Renderer
slices.jtbd: When implementing the visual capture subsystem for this epic, I want a headless Playwright rendering pipeline capturing 1440x900 and 375x812 viewports with exact DOM geometry, so that synthesized layouts are rendered into high-fidelity mockups with measurable geometry.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a synthesized layout document,
When rendered via the Playwright vision harness at 1440x900 desktop and 375x812 mobile viewports,
Then it produces pixel-accurate visual renders and extracts complete DOM bounding box geometry.
Given a rendering timeout or browser crash,
When captured by the harness supervisor,
Then it retries execution within defined limits and reports actionable diagnostic telemetry.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Headless browser execution time and DOM geometry extraction memory footprint
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Render capture success rate >= 99.8% across both viewports

slices.title: Deontic Gate and Visual Audit Interface
slices.jtbd: When building the audit interface and gate for this epic, I want a deontic gate validator and inspection UI checking zero optical noise, anti-slop color palette rules, and WCAG AAA contrast, so that substandard designs are intercepted before delivery.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a rendered design mockup and DOM geometry map,
When evaluated by the deontic gate,
Then it verifies zero optical noise, confirms strict anti-slop palette adherence, and asserts WCAG AAA contrast ratios (>= 7:1 for normal text).
Given a design failing contrast or containing visual noise,
When inspected in the audit UI,
Then the interface highlights offending DOM elements with exact color and contrast metrics.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Client-side image analysis and audit rule evaluation frame rate
slices.sixSigmaMetric: False positive audit rejection rate < 0.5% and WCAG AAA compliance rate = 100%

slices.title: Designer Engine Test Pyramid and Deontic Verification Suite
slices.jtbd: When implementing the quality assurance suite for this epic, I want full test pyramid coverage across unit, integration, and E2E layers, so that layout synthesis, Playwright rendering, and deontic gating operate reliably without regression.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given unit tests for semantic token resolution and layout synthesis,
When executed against edge-case configurations,
Then all assertions pass verifying 100% elimination of mock structures.
Given integration and E2E tests for Playwright rendering and deontic gate evaluation,
When executed across 1440x900 and 375x812 viewports,
Then the end-to-end journey completes with valid DOM geometry and verified WCAG AAA audit passes.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Test suite execution wall-clock time in CI/CD pipeline
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Defect escape rate = 0 and automated test coverage >= 95%
